home.objectives: Because real change begins when people are seen, supported and empowered.

about.mission: Empowering communities through technology, education, economic inclusion, wellness & support persons with disabilities.

founder.name: Mercy Wanjau
founder.bio: Mercy Wanjau is a seasoned commercial lawyer, governance professional, and public sector leader. She currently serves as the Secretary to the Cabinet of the Republic of Kenya. Her expertise spans ICT regulation, policy development, corporate governance, and public administration. She has previously served as the Acting Director-General and Director of Legal Services at the Communications Authority of Kenya, where she played a key role in shaping Kenya’s digital and regulatory landscape.

objectives.intro: Rooted in a passion for creative problem-solving, we turn ideas into reality and stand as a beacon of hope for those striving for a better tomorrow.
